name: Weekly active users
definition: Licensed people with at least one Claude Code session in the week ÷ licensed people; by team (SWE, DS, SRE)
dataSource: Claude Code analytics dashboard (Teams/Enterprise) or OpenTelemetry claude_code.session.count by user [CLM-657] [CLM-656]
pilotTarget: ≥ 70% of the pilot cohort weekly by week 3 (assumption)
guardrail: Do not mandate use; track voluntary use

name: Active days per user
definition: Days with a Claude Code session per active user per week
guardrail: Cost per active user stays within budget (MET-14)

name: Agent-assisted pull requests
definition: Merged PRs with Claude Code attribution ÷ all merged PRs, per repository in the pilot
dataSource: Git host; Claude Code adds a Co-Authored-By trailer and a PR attribution line by default [CLM-664] [CLM-632]; OpenTelemetry claude_code.pull_request.count [CLM-656]
guardrail: MET-08 change failure rate and MET-09 escaped defects do not worsen

name: Hours saved per user per week (self-reported, sampled)
definition: Median of a 2-question weekly pulse (hours saved; what task) from pilot users, cross-checked against MET-05 and MET-06
pilotTarget: Median ≥ 2 h/week, the conservative ROI case (break-even is ~1 h at base, value/roi-model.md)
guardrail: Self-reports overstate; never used alone (METR found perceived speedups where measured time rose [CLM-650])

name: PR cycle time
definition: Median hours from first commit to merge for pilot-team PRs vs the same teams' 8-week pre-pilot baseline and vs a comparison team
baseline: 8 weeks before pilot start, same repositories
guardrail: Review depth: median review comments per PR does not fall by more than 20%

name: Lead time for changes
definition: DORA: time from code committed to code running in production, median, pilot services [CLM-655]
pilotTarget: Directional improvement; full read at the 90-day review (assumption)

name: Deployment frequency
definition: DORA: production deployments per service per week [CLM-655]

name: Change failure rate
definition: DORA: share of deployments causing a failure that needs remediation [CLM-655]
pilotTarget: No worse than baseline (DORA 2024 linked AI adoption with lower delivery stability, so this is a hard gate [CLM-653])
guardrail: This is the guardrail for MET-03, MET-05, MET-06

name: Escaped defects and security findings
definition: Defects found after merge and SAST/secret-scan findings per 100 merged PRs, agent-assisted vs not
pilotTarget: Agent-assisted PRs no worse than others
guardrail: Any PAN or secret exposure is a stop-the-line event

name: Policy events
definition: Hook blocks, permission denials and managed-policy violations per 1,000 tool calls
dataSource: OpenTelemetry claude_code.tool_decision events and hook logs [CLM-684]
pilotTarget: Falling trend after week 2 (users learn the rules)
guardrail: Zero tolerated PAN/secret writes reaching a commit

name: Developer experience
definition: Monthly survey (SPACE-informed): satisfaction with the tool, perceived flow, cognitive load, would-recommend (0-10)
baseline: Pre-pilot survey of the same cohort
guardrail: Skills: juniors keep conceptual understanding (an Anthropic trial found lower quiz scores when juniors delegated rather than asked conceptual questions [CLM-626])

name: Roadmap throughput
definition: Roadmap items (epics) delivered per quarter by pilot teams vs plan and vs the prior quarter

name: Time to first release of a new product
definition: Weeks from approved spec to first production release for new products started after rollout, vs comparable past launches
pilotTarget: Tracked from the first post-rollout launch
guardrail: Launch quality: incidents in first 30 days

name: Cost per active user
definition: Claude Code spend ÷ active users per month, by team
dataSource: Admin console spend reports, or cloud billing on Bedrock/Vertex plus OpenTelemetry claude_code.cost.usage [CLM-620] [CLM-656]
baseline: Enterprise average $150-250 per developer per month [CLM-619]
pilotTarget: Within the agreed budget; outliers reviewed, not capped blindly

name: Team-specific cycle times
definition: DS: notebook-to-production lead time and experiment iterations per week; SRE: MTTA/MTTR for incidents and toil hours per week
dataSource: Model registry and Jira (DS); incident tooling and on-call logs (SRE)
pilotTarget: Directional; reported per team at week 6
guardrail: Model validation steps (SR 11-7) and incident approvals are unchanged
